shared.working: Working on it. You can leave this screen; the result is kept.
shared.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.

transcribe-file.title: Transcribe
transcribe-file.about: Turns a recording in your files into timed words, for captions, search and finding a stretch by what is said.
transcribe-file.hearInHint: Its own language is used when this is left as it is.
transcribe-file.again: Saved transcript. Transcribing it again returns the same words.
transcribe-file.hearing: Hearing the recording. Long videos take a while, and the transcript is kept when it is done.

read-file-words.title: Read a file's words
read-file-words.about: Reads what a document says, so search and every AI can find it.
read-file-words.cut: Shortened to fit. The file's full words are kept with it.
read-file-words.skipped: Skipped. This file already has its words.
read-file-words.again: Reading it again reads the file again.

start-team-review.title: Team review
start-team-review.about: One of your AIs does a job and another checks it, back and forth until the checker approves or the round limit is reached.
start-team-review.roundsHint: How many times the work may go back and forth.
start-team-review.again: The same request key returns the same review, so starting again does not begin a second one.

send-to-all-ais.title: Send to all my AIs
send-to-all-ais.about: One message to every AI you use, kept word for word so each one can read it.
send-to-all-ais.sent: Sent. Being woken is not the same as having read it.

suggest-next-edit.title: What to make next
suggest-next-edit.about: The next video to edit, from recordings you have not used yet.
suggest-next-edit.destinationHint: Pick where the video will be posted.

set-file-facts.title: File facts
set-file-facts.about: Add dates, places and your own fields to a file. Clear a field to take it away.

send-edit-to-editor.title: Send to editor
send-edit-to-editor.about: Prepares a saved edit as an editable Filmcraft project, using your Namespace files on this computer.
send-edit-to-editor.leftOut: Left out, because it cannot be kept yet
send-edit-to-editor.noSave: Nothing was exported. Source videos are not downloaded.

attach-finished-video.title: Attach finished video
attach-finished-video.about: Mark the video you exported as the finished version of an edit, so the edit opens with it.
